# Revolt Lithium Energy Solutions
> Muzaffarnagar (Uttar Pradesh, India) maker of Livgreen and Redtuff LiFePO4 batteries for e-rickshaws, electric two-wheelers, inverters and solar storage.

- E-rickshaw: 51.2V 105Ah, 5.376 kWh, 16S1P prismatic LFP, 44 kg, 20 A / 25 A charge, 36-month warranty (Livgreen, Redtuff RT-5.376KWH)
- E-2-wheeler: 48V 30Ah (LG-4830), 60V 30Ah (LG-6030, RT-6030, Revolt RLES), 60V 32Ah (LG 6032), 72V 30Ah (LG-7230), 36-month warranty
- High-voltage: Livgreen 96V 105Ah
- Inverter & solar (60-month warranty): Redtuff RT-1.344KWH 12.8V, RT-2.688KWH 25.6V, RT-5.040KWH 48V; Livgreen LG 2.688KWH 25.6V, LG-5.040KWH 48V (all 105Ah)
